acceptance_predicates.description: Published fan-out members decode as complete bounded ASB RunRequest values with no unknown or omitted required fields.
A deterministic local fixture is negotiated and transmitted through the Unix control transport to RunnerBackend and admitted.
Agent, provider, model, workload, catalog, workload/scorer revisions, cassette and credential-reference digests survive unchanged into the transmitted request.
Missing development authentication, signatures, and key management remain visible warnings and never block local/mock validation.
A privacy-safe receipt binds exact ASB/TUI heads, transport evidence, and artifact digests without secrets.

definition_of_done: ASB and TUI exact-head transport qualification passes with independent review and hosted checks.
The final receipt records the complete request contract and preserves AR-1696 as any remaining frontend coverage dependency.

gates.description: The complete RunRequest schema and bounded limits validate before backend admission.
Negotiation, framing, backend admission and typed response validation pass over the actual local control transport.
